name: Building on the right foundation
promise: From what salvation is to a steady, growing walk with God: twelve foundations every believer can build on.
why: For new believers and anyone who never had a solid grounding. It starts with what salvation is and how it begins (turning from the old life, believing in Jesus, the new birth), then settles who you now are (a new creation, made righteous, empowered by grace, marked by communion and baptism), then builds the daily habits (the Word, prayer, meeting with the church) and ends with growing up: the lifelong salvation of the soul.

days.theme: Saved from sin into a whole new life
days.key_quote: The gospel that the apostles preach provided salvation from the principles, the power and the presence of sin.

days.theme: Turning from rebellion to God's rule
days.key_quote: That's why the first kingdom message is about repentance. We will need to turn around. We need to give up our ways of rebellion.

days.theme: Know for sure that you are his
days.key_quote: Your spirit, your human spirit, is calibrated on the same frequency as the Holy Spirit. So the Holy Spirit can communicate with your human spirit. That communication is what we call the inward witness.

days.theme: Born of the Spirit to see God's kingdom
days.key_quote: Your being born again gives you the opportunity of perception, then after perception you will need choice to walk under God's government.

days.theme: Know who you have become in Christ
days.key_quote: The reason why you are living now as a new creation is that you are living by the Holy Spirit. It means that your life cannot be the way it was.

days.theme: Declared righteous as a gift, then living it
days.key_quote: This righteousness that was given to us was not a function of something that you achieved by your own power.

days.theme: Grace: God's own power to live above sin
days.key_quote: Christian life was designed to run on the fuel called grace.

days.theme: Covenant signs: the cup and the water
days.key_quote: Your baptism is a declaration to this world that I've passed on from you. I'm no longer part of you.

days.theme: Build on the Word: hear it and do it
days.key_quote: The difference between your physical mirror and the mirror of the word of God is that the mirror of God's word reveals who you are supposed to be.

days.theme: Meet your Father in the secret place
days.key_quote: If God does not touch your heart, God cannot change your life. He changes your life by touching your heart.

days.theme: Gathering with believers where God meets us
days.key_quote: So in our fellowship meetings, the people we interact with, the personalities we interact with are not just the physical personalities that are present in church.

days.theme: Saved, being saved, and yet to be saved
days.key_quote: It is true when we say we are saved. It is also still true when we say we are being saved.
